test_debug_architecture_present: partial — the public webinar describes mandatory PHY Test Modes (Master pin configuration table), mandatory per-Port Transport Test Modes (Static0 / Static1 / PRBS), and the Monitor device class for snooping and bus injection. DFT scan / BIST / JTAG are not covered (they live at the SoC integration level).

spec_provided_observability.name: PING Slave Status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-Slave three-state status (Not Attached / Attached / Alert) in every PING frame — coarse health check.

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-Slave Interrupt Status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Hierarchical SCP_IntStat_1/2/3 + per-Port DPst_IntStat capture Parity, Bus Clash, Port Ready, Test Fail, and ImpDef interrupt sources.

spec_provided_observability.name: Parity bit per Frame
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Single-bit error detection; computed on the physical level read from the bus; window = BitSlot[44,1] previous → BitSlot[44,0] current; reportable with a 1-frame delay.

spec_provided_observability.name: Command Status field
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-Read/Write response: ACK / NAK (Command Failed) / Command_Ignored (non-existent / not attached / reserved register).

spec_provided_observability.name: SSP (Synchronization Stream Position)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Periodic synchronization tick in PING frames (≥ once every 100 ms) — observable safe-reconfig point and multi-stream alignment signal.

spec_provided_observability.name: Monitor BREQ / BREL
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Bus-arbitration state — observable Master vs Monitor ownership.

spec_provided_observability.name: PHY Test Modes (Master pin states)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Master-side pin configuration so external Master or test equipment can drive Data/Clock instead of the Master, including ability to disable the master bus-keeper (M_KeeperOff) and to park Data or both Clock and Data Off/high-Z.

spec_provided_observability.name: Transport Test Modes per Port
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Static0 (helps detect Bus Clash when another port drives same BitSlots), Static1 (helps generate Bus Clash deliberately), PRBS (255-bit maximal-length 8-bit LFSR sequence; receiver synchronizes in up to 8 bits; interrupt on error).

spec_provided_observability.name: Monitor (test equipment)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Optional device class that snoops the bus most of the time and may temporarily take over to issue Read/Write commands (BREQ/BREL arbitration).

phy_test_modes_master_table.legend: 'x' means functional (driven normally) in that column.
phy_test_modes_master_table.note: External master or test equipment can drive data and clock instead of master and replace the master bus-keeper.

transport_test_modes_per_port_table.Static0: Drives all-zeros on the port BitSlots; helps detect Bus Clash Errors caused by another port also driving the same BitSlots.
transport_test_modes_per_port_table.Static1: Drives all-ones on the port BitSlots; helps generate Bus Clash Errors deliberately for fault-injection testing.
transport_test_modes_per_port_table.PRBS: 8-bit LFSR — TX initial Q[8:1] = 0xFF; characteristic polynomial corresponds to the diagram in the webinar (taps in PRBS_out chain). Generates 255-bit maximal-length sequence. RX side initial Q[8:1] = 0xD2; receiver synchronizes in up to 8 bits. PRBS_error output toggles on mismatch and can raise an interrupt.

interrupt_sources.trigger: Parity bit mismatch over the Parity Calculation Window; Slave shall set NAK in current frame and raise this interrupt.
Two devices drove the same BitSlot with conflicting Logic 1 / Logic 1-from-different-source patterns — Modified-NRZI parity will detect some of these as well.
PRBS test mode receiver detected a mismatch.
Channel Prepare state machine reached Ready (NF=0, P=1).
At least one Interrupt condition raised on a Slave — Slave reports 'Alert' status (vs Attached) in PING. Master must Read SCP_IntStat_* to diagnose.
Slave-initiated Interrupt/Wake signal in Control Word; serves as in-band IRQ + wake for low-power jack detection in ClockStopMode1.
Per-frame Command Status = NAK; Parity Error or Bus Clash detected — Master may retransmit.
Per-frame Command Status — Slave is non-existent, not attached (lost sync or power), or register is reserved / not implemented.

interrupt_latency_bound: 32-frame max latency from interrupt generation in Slave to Slave reporting Alert in PING and Master servicing via Read of SCP_IntStat_* registers.
interrupt_request: SoundWire carries interrupts in-band — PREQ bit + per-Slave 'Alert' three-state status in every PING frame + hierarchical SCP_IntStat_1/2/3 registers + per-Port DPst_IntStat. No separate IRQ pin required.
monitor_role: Test equipment in snooping/analyzer mode most of the time. Can temporarily take over the bus via BREQ/BREL arbitration to inject Read/Write commands. Receives sync from Master's static + dynamic sync words; if Monitor loses sync, the command defaults to PING with BREQ cleared and Master reclaims ownership.
notes: MIPI SoundWire defines protocol-level observability and bus-injection interfaces; DFT (scan, BIST, JTAG, MBIST) lives at SoC integration level and is left to the implementing controller / codec IP block.
